scripts.start: npm run build -w ui && npm start -w server
scripts.desktop: npm run build -w ui && npm start -w @syph/desktop
scripts.typecheck: tsc -p core --noEmit && tsc -p server --noEmit && tsc -p ui --noEmit
scripts.dist: npm run build -w ui && node scripts/build-app.mjs && npm run dist -w @syph/desktop
